title: (Senior) Supply Chain Consultant (m/w/d)
description: About the role Every RELEX implementation is a solution built from scratch for one customer: their processes, their data, their targets. (Senior) Supply Chain Consultants shape both sides of that build — the business processes and KPIs the customer will run on, and the configuration that makes them work in the system. Depending on your background you will lean more towards one side than the other. This is a heavily customer-facing role. What you'll be doing Understand how the customer really plans.  Prepare, facilitate and document workshops to gather and specify business requirements, and run the data analysis that shows where the strengths and the gaps actually are. Design the target picture  — planning processes, roles and the KPIs the project is measured on — and guide customers towards RELEX best practice, including where their current way of working needs to change. Build it.  Configuration, business rules, workflows and reporting that deliver the design you just agreed, and that hold up in operation: nightly run performance, scalability and maintainability, not just functional correctness. Make the value case tangible  for customer leadership: define how forecast accuracy, availability, inventory and cost will be measured, and report honestly on where we stand. Take it live.  Coordinate User Acceptance Testing, resolve what testing surfaces, and upskill super users so the customer is proficient and self-sustaining after go-live. Own adoption, not just delivery.  A technically correct solution that nobody uses is not a successful project. Document what you built  — requirements, scope and configuration — so the project team, the customer and our Continuous Services colleagues can work with it after handover. Work across disciplines : with Technical Consultants on the data model, interfaces and the customer's ERP landscape, and with Project Managers on scope, effort and timelines. Within RELEX Challenge and develop implementation best practice across industries (grocery, DIY, home goods, pharma, wholesale and more) Share knowledge with the team as both a trainer and a participant, and support colleagues who are earlier in their journey Work with our global teams on international projects and bring practices between regions Use AI tooling actively in your daily work — we expect curiosity here and give you room to experiment   What we're looking for Around 2+ years of relevant experience  in supply chain or retail planning, demand and inventory planning, or in implementing / consulting on planning software. A degree in supply chain management, business, engineering, mathematics or computer science is a good foundation — but we care more about what you have actually done. Structured thinking and comfort with ambiguity.  Many customer requirements arrive without a ready-made answer. You break them down, work with data, and arrive at a defensible recommendation. Communication that works across levels  — from super users in a training room to senior stakeholders in a steering committee, including the conversations where the message is not what the customer hoped to hear. Business-fluent German and English.  Both are used daily. Willingness to travel  depending on the project phase. Technical affinity : SQL, scripting, or an interest to pick these up Additionally, for the Senior level: Several years of consulting or implementation experience, including  demonstrable ownership of a workstream or a smaller project end-to-end  — scope, risk, timeline and completion, not just your own tasks Reliable effort estimation for standard and custom requirements, supporting scoping and SOW discussions Experience coaching and mentoring less experienced colleagues Confidence in front of senior customer stakeholders, including steering committees Hands-on experience with a supply chain planning system, either as a user or as an implementer Experience defining and tracking KPIs or building a value case Who we are We’re bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. title: Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Mission Brief   You are the guardian and the challenger of our security posture. At Isar Aerospace, the systems that build our rockets and the ground systems that launch them are mission critical, and protecting them takes more than good design. It takes someone who will attack their own work to be sure it holds.  We are looking for a deeply hands-on Senior Security Engineer. You live in the consoles, the rule sets and the code. You own our secure access and network security controls, our endpoint and identity security stack, and our detection content, and you operate them yourself rather than directing from the sidelines. You wear two hats: the Builder who implements and runs the controls that keep us safe, and the Adversary who keeps testing whether those controls and detections actually fire.  This is a senior engineering role with the spirit of an architect. You are expected to design what you operate, not just configure it: pick the pattern, write it down, and make it hold at fleet scale. A versatile engineer with real depth, comfortable switching from a firewall rule set to a detection query to a directory hardening sprint in the same week, and a technical anchor others lean on.  Your Role in Our Space Mission     SASE and Network Security   Own and operate our SASE platform , including revamping Internet Security policies and redefining Private Access policies.  Drive firewall security with the network team: own network security engineering and segmentation strategy, analyze rule sets, identify gaps, and see remediation through together with network engineering, who own the devices.  Coordinate firewall-adjacent controls: IPS, AV, sandboxing and DDoS protection.  Manage our DNS security and WAF solutions , including our edge and CDN-based protection services.  Security Posture and Hardening   Apply CIS Benchmarks to raise posture across firewalls, endpoints, our cloud identity platform and our cloud productivity suite.  Lead the clean-up and hardening of our on-premises and cloud identity directories together with the infrastructure team, then keep both hardened on an ongoing basis.  Drive our phishing-resistant MFA and privileged access programme, including just-in-time elevation and the remediation of the attack paths we find.  Own certificate lifecycle and PKI operations: key ceremonies, automated renewal, and input to our post-quantum migration plan.  Detection and Visibility   Manage and tune our IPS/IDS platforms; write and maintain custom IDS signatures, and operate network sensors for NTA appliances.  Build and maintain detections in our SIEM and apply MITRE ATT&CK to detection engineering and use-case design in support of the SOC.  Extend visibility into OT with purpose-built OT monitoring tooling.  Act as an L3 incident responder for escalated security events, and turn every finding into a fix, a new detection or a hardened configuration.  Security Stack and Automation   Own our endpoint detection and response, data protection and CASB platforms as their technical owner.  Script and build internal tooling in PowerShell and Python, so controls and checks run themselves.  Design and Engineering Partnership   Design what you operate: run threat modeling and attack-path analysis on the systems you own, choose the pattern, and document standards others can execute against.  Evaluate tooling and support vendor selection and renewal decisions in your domain, with a clear view of what each control costs us and what it buys.  Embed security with engineering: partner with IT, infrastructure, manufacturing and mission teams to implement and validate controls in their environments across both IT and OT, respecting launch-window and change-freeze constraints and producing the evidence our audits depend on.  Qualification Checklist   Experience: 10+ years in security engineering, with real ownership of production security tooling, not policy or advisory work.  Architect Spirit: you can step back from the console, design the target state, write the pattern down, and then go build it yourself.  SASE: hands-on experience administering an enterprise SASE platform end to end, not just consuming it.  Hardening: experience applying CIS Benchmarks to firewalls, endpoints, cloud identity and cloud productivity platforms in production, plus experience rolling out phishing-resistant MFA or privileged access management.  Networking and Firewalls: solid fundamentals, enough to own segmentation strategy and to drive rule set analysis and gap remediation with a network team that owns the devices. Experience with CDN-based WAF and edge protection services.  Security Stack Depth: strong background across endpoint detection and response, data protection, SIEM and detection query languages, cloud identity and on-premises directory hardening, certificate lifecycle and PKI operations, ideally including a large-scale directory clean-up or remediation effort.  Detection Engineering: practical MITRE ATT&CK-driven detection work, and experience writing custom IDS/IPS signatures.  Operational Depth: strong capability in detection, incident response and vulnerability management, with time spent on escalated incidents.  Automation: scripting ability in PowerShell and Python, plus infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code experience.  IT and OT: comfortable working across both. Working knowledge of OT protocols such as EtherNet/IP, OPC UA and Modbus, and familiarity with OT network monitoring, is a strong plus.  Autonomy: operates with very high autonomy as an internal expert, taking full ownership of their work and guiding others.  Mentoring: mentors engineers and analysts on the team, and acts as technical lead in cross-functional projects.  Communication: clear communication and collaboration skills, able to translate technical risk for a range of audiences and to work controls through other teams.  Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or the equivalent through relevant certifications and hands-on experience.  Bonus Skills   Experience in aerospace, defense, energy, manufacturing or other OT-heavy, safety-critical environments.  Prior SOC or incident response team experience.  Cloud security depth in a major public cloud and its native security services.  Familiarity with industry standards such as ISO 27001 and NIST.  Relevant certifications, defensive or engineering (e.g., Security+, GCIA) and offensive (e.g., OSCP or equivalent), are both valued.    What We Offer   Real Ownership: the security tooling that protects a premier European space company is yours to run, rebuild and prove.  Impact: the opportunity to directly protect the future of spaceflight as we approach our first orbital launch.  Collaboration: work hand-in-hand with brilliant engineers and IT professionals on genuinely hard problems.    Benefits  Employee Participation Program: Share in our success through our virtual company share program 6 weeks of vacation: Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day Relocation support: Benefit from our relocation bonus with deductible expenses up to an agreed amount Wellness allowance: Stay healthy and fit with our yearly allowance for wellness activities (e.g., Gym, Massages) Individual learning allowance: Grow your skills with an individual learning budget granted after the probation period Physical and mental well-being: Access via OpenUp the online support from certified psychologists and lifestyle experts at no cost to you and your family And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team.   Who we are We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space. Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations. We are a fast-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. The company is privately funded by world-leading technology investors with strong commitment and support and our team is made of driven and talented people with a real passion for space innovation. We're making rockets in a way that hasn't been done before disrupting a traditional industry. If you are up for the challenge, want to work on cutting-edge projects and be part of a team changing the world for better, come, join us and launch your career! Want to find out more about us? Visit www.isaraerospace.com   Data Protection We process your personal data for the purpose of managing the recruitment process and assessing your application. title: Senior Business Development Manager - New Business, UK & Europe
description: About GeminiSense GeminiSense is a collaboration between Bold Communications Ltd and Innovative Business Software (IBS) , two established software businesses within the Valsoft Corporation portfolio. The collaboration brings together the technology, experience and deep industry expertise of both organisations to deliver a next-generation, event-driven monitoring platform for the security and monitoring industry. GeminiSense enables organisations to monitor, identify and respond to critical events in real time, bringing together alarm and incident management, CCTV and video monitoring, lone-worker protection, IoT and sensor monitoring, communications, task management and third-party integrations within a powerful, unified monitoring environment. The platform is designed for demanding operational environments including Alarm Receiving Centres (ARCs), security monitoring centres, airports, corporate and industrial organisations, facilities management, manufacturing, local government, retail and other security-critical operations. Backed by two Valsoft-owned software companies, GeminiSense combines deep industry knowledge with the resources and ambition to build a significant presence across the UK and European markets. We are now looking for an exceptional Senior Business Development Manager – New Business to play a key role in accelerating that growth. The Opportunity This is a new-business hunter role. We are looking for an ambitious, commercially aggressive and highly proactive Senior Business Development Manager who thrives on creating opportunities, opening doors and closing new business. This is not an account-management role , nor is it a position for someone who expects to rely on a steady flow of inbound leads. You will be responsible for building your own pipeline, identifying and targeting high-value prospective customers, engaging senior decision-makers and converting opportunities into new customers and recurring revenue. You will own the complete sales process from initial prospecting and discovery through product demonstration, proposal development, commercial negotiation and contract signature. You will have significant autonomy to develop the UK and European territory and will be expected to bring the energy, persistence and commercial discipline required to build a substantial new-business pipeline. Your objective is simple: create pipeline, win new logos and generate new recurring revenue. Key Responsibilities Own new-business development across the UK and European markets. Develop and execute a clear territory, vertical-market and target-account strategy. Identify and penetrate high-value prospective customers across GeminiSense’s target markets. Build and maintain a substantial qualified new-business pipeline. Generate your own opportunities through proactive outbound prospecting, direct outreach, networking, referrals, partners, industry events and targeted account development. Conduct consistent, high-quality prospecting into target organisations and named strategic accounts. Identify multiple routes into target organisations and develop relationships with key stakeholders and influencers. Engage confidently with senior decision-makers including CEOs, Managing Directors, Operations Directors, Security Directors, Control Room Managers, IT leaders and other relevant executives. Conduct effective discovery to understand each prospect’s operational, security, technical and commercial challenges. Translate customer requirements into compelling GeminiSense solutions with clearly defined operational and commercial benefits. Position and sell the broader GeminiSense platform across alarm and incident management, CCTV/video monitoring, lone-worker protection, IoT and sensor monitoring, communications, workflow and associated monitoring applications. Deliver compelling presentations, discovery sessions and product demonstrations, working with technical and product specialists where appropriate. Develop strong commercial proposals, business cases and ROI justifications. Own opportunities throughout the complete sales cycle, from initial contact through to contract signature. Maintain momentum throughout the sales process and proactively identify and overcome obstacles to closing. Develop relationships across multiple stakeholders within prospective customers to maximise the probability of successful conversion. Negotiate pricing, commercial terms and contracts. Consistently achieve or exceed agreed new ARR and revenue targets. Maintain a disciplined, accurate and appropriately weighted sales pipeline. Deliver reliable monthly and quarterly sales forecasts. Develop strategic relationships with technology partners, integrators and other organisations capable of generating new opportunities. Represent GeminiSense at relevant exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings and industry events throughout the UK and Europe. Monitor competitors, market developments and emerging opportunities across the security and monitoring technology markets. Provide structured customer and market feedback to Product, Marketing and Leadership teams. Work closely with Marketing to develop targeted campaigns while remaining personally accountable for pipeline creation and new customer acquisition. What We’re Looking For We are looking for a proven new-business salesperson , not simply someone with sales experience. The successful candidate will have: A demonstrable track record of winning new B2B customers and exceeding sales targets . Strong evidence of personally generating significant sales pipeline rather than relying predominantly on marketing-generated or inbound leads. Experience selling complex B2B software, SaaS or technology solutions. A history of successfully developing new territories, opening strategic accounts and winning new logos. The confidence and ability to prospect consistently at senior and executive levels. Excellent discovery and consultative selling capabilities. Strong commercial instincts combined with a relentless focus on progressing and closing opportunities. Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B sales cycles. Confidence negotiating significant commercial agreements. The ability to translate sophisticated technical capabilities into clear commercial and operational benefits. Strong presentation, communication and negotiation skills. Excellent pipeline-management and forecasting discipline. High levels of personal accountability, resilience and self-motivation. The ability to operate independently and effectively within a remote environment. A willingness to travel throughout the UK and Europe as required. Highly Desirable Industry Experience Candidates with a strong track record within one or more of the following markets will be particularly attractive: Security Technology | Alarm Monitoring | Alarm Receiving Centres (ARCs) | Security Monitoring Centres | CCTV & Video Management | PSIM | Lone-Worker Solutions | Manned Guarding Technology | IoT & Sensor Monitoring | Access Control | Smart Buildings | Critical Event Management | Incident Management Software | Physical Security Software An established network of contacts within the security, monitoring, facilities-management or related technology sectors would be a significant advantage. Experience selling into large enterprise customers and complex operational environments would also be highly desirable. Additional European language skills and previous experience selling across multiple European territories would be advantageous. The Person We are looking for someone who is: Competitive. Persistent. Resilient. Commercial. Accountable. Driven. You should genuinely enjoy the challenge of opening doors that are initially closed. An unanswered email, unsuccessful call or initial rejection should not end your pursuit of an attractive account. You will identify another stakeholder, find another route into the organisation and continue developing the opportunity. You will be comfortable creating opportunities from a relatively cold territory and will not require a constant stream of marketing-generated leads to remain productive. You will be highly organised and disciplined in how you manage your territory, pipeline and opportunities, while maintaining the urgency required to drive deals forward. You will combine the persistence and determination of a true new-business hunter with the professionalism, credibility and consultative skills required to sell sophisticated technology into large and potentially mission-critical organisations. Above all, you will have a demonstrable history of turning prospecting activity into pipeline and pipeline into revenue. How Success Will Be Measured This is a performance-driven sales position with clear accountability for results. Key performance measures will include: New Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) / revenue generated New customers and new logos won Qualified new-business pipeline created Pipeline coverage against sales target Target-account penetration Outbound prospecting effectiveness Qualified meetings and demonstrations generated Opportunity creation and conversion Sales-cycle progression Win rates Forecast accuracy Achievement against quarterly and annual sales targets The successful candidate will be expected to maintain sufficient qualified pipeline coverage to support consistent achievement of their revenue target. Compensation We want to attract an exceptional salesperson and recognise that compensation needs to reflect the calibre, experience and proven performance of the successful individual. Base salary will therefore be dependent on the candidate’s experience, industry knowledge and, most importantly, their proven track record of winning new business and consistently delivering against sales targets. In addition to base salary, the position will include a highly competitive, uncapped commission plan directly linked to new-business performance. The commission structure will reward overachievement, with accelerators above 100% of target , ensuring that exceptional sales performance results in exceptional earnings. There will be no cap on earning potential for a salesperson who consistently exceeds their targets. Why GeminiSense? This is an opportunity to join GeminiSense at an exciting stage of its development and play a significant role in building its presence across the UK and Europe. GeminiSense combines the expertise and capabilities of Bold Communications Ltd and Innovative Business Software A/S , both part of the Valsoft Corporation portfolio. This provides the successful candidate with the opportunity to take an innovative technology platform to market while benefiting from the experience, industry knowledge and backing of established software businesses. This is not about simply inheriting and managing a mature sales territory. You will have the opportunity to build one. You will identify target markets, penetrate strategic accounts, establish new relationships, win new customers and help establish GeminiSense as a significant player within the UK and European security and monitoring technology markets. For the right salesperson, this role offers significant autonomy, market opportunity and uncapped earning potential, alongside the opportunity to make a highly visible contribution to the growth and success of GeminiSense. If you’re a proven new-business hunter who enjoys opening doors, creating opportunities, winning new customers and closing deals, we want to hear from you. #bold Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Join Axon and be a Force for Good. At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. Your Impact Axon’s RF sensors detect and locate drones so public safety and critical infrastructure teams can protect airspace. You will own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor capabilities — spanning regression, integration, and real-world validation — so those systems are trustworthy in the lab and in the field. You will work closely with RF Engineering at the intersection of software, hardware, and real-world RF, helping turn technical evidence into confident product decisions. Work Location: This role is based out of our Kassel, Germany office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success. What You’ll Do Own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor software from design through release, adding rigor through regression, integration, and real-world validation. Design and own test strategies spanning feature, regression, integration / interface, system, and field validation. Combine automated coverage with targeted manual validation based on risk and technical feasibility. Develop in-depth functional tests for individual components of the RF sensor software, and keep those tests maintainable as the product evolves. Reproduce, isolate, and characterize issues on real sensor hardware and in test environments; capture clear reproduction steps, logs, and environment details. Build and maintain hardware-backed automated regression tests and supporting test tooling. Monitor and improve development and test systems and test hardware so environments stay stable, observable, and ready for daily use. Partner closely with RF Engineering and independently verify behavior in realistic environments and across system interfaces. Execute system, release, field, and acceptance testing with release stakeholders. Document test results and defects clearly, and contribute to software design reviews and after-action reviews for the work you own. Share knowledge with the wider team, give actionable feedback, and support newer engineers and interns through pairing, reviews, and onboarding. Use approved agentic AI tools regularly to design tests, analyze results, and draft documentation and review AI output against quality, security, and performance standards before you rely on it.   What You Bring A degree or vocational qualification in electrical engineering, computer science, embedded systems, or a related field 3+ years of experience testing software that runs on or with hardware (embedded products, devices, sensors, or similar systems), including independently owning the test and quality approach for that work. Experience with RF, embedded, sensor, or similarly hardware-integrated systems, with the technical aptitude and curiosity to develop deep expertise in RF sensor technologies. Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated tests or test tooling, ideally in Python pytest, with the ability to independently support hardware-backed regression testing. Comfort working in Linux-based systems (SSH, Networking). A collaborative, quality-focused working style: you Join Forces with others, Own It on the quality of the work you take on, and speak up with candor when something is unclear or broken. It’s a plus if you have experience with drones or hardware-in-the-loop / continuous integration test setups and an interest in supporting others as they grow. Don’t meet every single requirement? title: Software Engineer, Platform
description: Software is eating the world, but AI is eating software. We live in unprecedented times – AI has the potential to exponentially augment human intelligence. Every person will have a personal tutor, coach, assistant, personal shopper, travel guide, and therapist throughout life. As the world adjusts to this new reality, leading platform companies are scrambling to build LLMs at billion scale, while large enterprises figure out how to add it to their products. To make them safe, aligned and actually useful, these models need human eval and reinforcement learning through human feedback (RLHF) during pre-training, fine-tuning, and production evaluations. This is the main innovation that’s enabled ChatGPT to get such a large headstart among competition. At Scale, our products include the Generative AI Data Engine, SGP, Donovan, and others that power the most advanced LLMs and generative models in the world through world-class RLHF, human data generation, model evaluation, safety, and alignment. The data we are producing is some of the most important work for how humanity will interact with AI. At the foundation of these products is the SGP Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will support the design and development of shared platforms used across Scale. This includes designing our foundational data platforms and lifecycle, architecting Scale’s core cloud infrastructure and orchestration stack, and redefining how engineers develop, build, test, and deploy software at Scale. title: Staff Engineer
description: Help make the world more hospitable The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences. You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building. If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here. About the role Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this: As Staff Engineer, you'll own the architecture, agents and skills that let every builder in your tribe ship sound, well-architected work without waiting on a handoff, at a moment when Mews has moved almost entirely to an agentic-first engineering model. The problem this role exists to solve is easy to state and hard to do: most technical decisions now get made by builders and the agents they run, not by senior engineers in review, so the standard has to be built into the tooling itself or the gaps show up in what customers touch. Mews is rebuilding hospitality software from the ground up at a genuinely unusual pace, which makes this one of the few staff engineering roles where the leverage you build gets used by everyone around you within weeks. You'll be attached to one tribe, reporting into its Director, and working alongside other staff engineers, staff product managers and staff designers across your division. Your job isn't to ship features. It's to produce the architecture, agents and skills that give every builder in the tribe the context to make sound calls on their own, and to stay hands-on with the hardest problems yourself: the gnarly migrations and system-wide refactors that need an approach invented rather than executed. As Mews moves builders to own a sub-metric end-to-end, with AI covering what they're lighter in, the risk isn't slower shipping, it's the architecture fragmenting underneath the speed. This role exists so the foundations get stronger as the tribe ships faster, not shakier. Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution. A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams. Experience - Desirable It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in: Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping. Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation. Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies. description: SLSQ427R384 At Databricks, we help public institutions use data and AI to improve services, increase productivity, and get more value from public data and technology investment. Databricks is looking for an Account Executive to own and grow some of our most strategic Public Sector customers in the UK government delivering against their core missions. The opportunity isn't one giant government data system; it's enabling institutions to connect, govern and use data and insight across boundaries while retaining control of their own data, responsibilities and decisions. Manage a portfolio that spans quick wins and longer, complex public-sector sales cycles simultaneously. Build and defend a strong renewal and expansion motion within existing accounts as a foundation for new growth. Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today. At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits. Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own. Your Impact As our Senior Search Engineer , you’ll support the Search Foundation Team by developing a modern, integrated search experience for our customers, providing them with a search API for product discovery and the foundations of search capabilities across domains. You will: Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend. Learn Scala and functional programming as your new main development tools Develop search-related libraries based on ElasticSearch and MongoDB Run and maintain a scalable search “infrastructure as code” on top of Kubernetes using terraform and multi-tenant architecture Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps. Taking part in on-call rotation (with the worldwide distributed team) for production systems Take part in on-call rotations with a worldwide distributed team for production systems. This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia office.  What Sets You Apart You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork. Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work. You bring: At least 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer working with languages on the JVM Search-related experience (preferably ElasticSearch) Strong DevOps mindset as you will drive lots of infrastructure improvements Interest in working with Scala using pragmatic functional programming patterns Practical work experience in developing server-side systems using the JVM Solid understanding of parallel and asynchronous programming, as well as non-blocking I/O Experience in developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable architectures (incl. sharding, replication, load balancing and failover) Fluent English for work in international teams A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role. Nice to Have:   Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures (incl., queues, notification topics, sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover). Experience working with Scala or other functional programming languages. Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust. Our Benefits Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most. 🩺 Comprehensive health benefits for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support 📚 Learning and development opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs 🍼 Family Leave Plus gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition 📈 Our equity participation program allows you to share in our success  For more information on our benefits, visit this page. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine. We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community.  For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices, visit this page .  Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Financial Controller (Remote)
description: Finance Controller Location: Fully remote Start date: ASAP Languages: Fluent English required Industry: Data Center Infrastructure / Technology About the Role Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing company specializing in the design, production, and installation of data center infrastructure . As the company scales its large, capital-intensive projects, we are seeking an experienced Finance Controller to own financial control, treasury, and contract governance across the business. This role is critical in an environment where long-cycle customer contracts, supplier payment terms, milestone billing, revenue recognition, and significant working capital swings directly impact the company's cash position . You'll work closely with Project, Operations, Procurement, Sales, Commercial, and Senior Leadership teams, providing financial visibility across projects while ensuring strong controls, accurate reporting, and healthy liquidity. Your Responsibilities Own financial oversight of complex customer, supplier, and subcontractor contracts , including milestones, payment terms, change orders, retentions, and cost-to-complete. Manage long-term contract revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15, including percentage-of-completion / input methods, contract assets, liabilities, and unbilled revenue. Monitor project profitability and financial risk , including cost overruns, margin erosion, schedule delays, and cash-at-risk. Own key financial controls, monthly close, management reporting, and audit coordination . Lead day-to-day and forward-looking cash flow management , including rolling weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts. Monitor and optimize working capital , including customer receivables, supplier terms, inventory, and project-related cash requirements. Manage banking relationships, credit facilities, project finance, and asset-backed lending where applicable. Monitor FX exposure across international equipment, materials, and contracts. Partner with Sales, Procurement, and Project teams on commercial terms, payment structures, guarantees, and financial risk before contracts are signed. Provide Senior Leadership with clear visibility into liquidity, funding requirements, project profitability, and overall financial performance . Required Qualifications 4+ years of experience in financial controlling or a similar finance role. Experience in EPC, infrastructure, construction, equipment manufacturing, data centers, or other project-based businesses . Strong experience with financial and management reporting under GAAP and/or IFRS . Advanced knowledge of ASC 606 / IFRS 15 and long-term contract revenue recognition. Demonstrated experience in treasury, cash flow management, and working capital within a project-based or capital-intensive business. Experience reviewing complex customer, supplier, and subcontractor contracts from a financial perspective. Strong understanding of project profitability, cost-to-complete, and financial risk. Comfortable working cross-functionally with Sales, Procurement, Legal, Project, Operations, and Senior Leadership . Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field . Fluent English communication skills. Preferred Qualifications CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent qualification. Previous Big 4 accounting or audit experience . Experience with data center infrastructure, EPC, construction, manufacturing, or large-scale equipment projects. Experience with project finance, credit facilities, or asset-backed lending . Experience managing multi-currency operations and FX exposure . Experience with ASC 842 / IFRS 16 . Experience building financial controls and processes in a high-growth organization. Why Join Us You will take on a key finance role within a fast-growing data center infrastructure company , with direct influence over the financial performance and liquidity of large-scale projects. This role offers high ownership and cross-functional exposure , working closely with commercial, operational, and leadership teams on projects where financial control and cash management are critical to success. You'll have the opportunity to help build and scale robust finance processes while working at the intersection of technology, infrastructure, and the rapidly growing data center industry . title: Inside Enterprise Account Executive | France
description: At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple. The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.   What you’ll do at Jamf:   The Inside Enterprise Account Executive role is an evangelist and subject matter expert, responsible for expanding sales within the Enterprise UK&I territory by selling the Whole Product Experience (WPE) and building out Jamf’s Apple Enterprise Management and Security footprint in the FRANCE Enterprise market (>1000 employees). The Inside Enterprise Account Executive is part of the Enterprise team and is responsible for the growth of recurring revenue (ARR) by retaining and growing both new and existing customers. It is responsible for driving thought leadership within the respective verticals, at multiple levels into accounts, concentrating on adoption strategies for implementing the WPE and will assist in formulating and guiding business validation cases in order to expedite adoption. The Inside Enterprise Account Executive will work closely with our partners and channel ecosystem to nurture and fulfil new business opportunities. This role is offered in France, preferrabily for candidates located and used to travel witin the Paris area #LI-Remote   What you can expect to do this role:   Grow existing and new customer relationships and elevate Jamf to a more strategic position within Enterprise accounts. Cultivate sales of Jamf’s Product Portfolio by helping organizations succeed with Apple within a list of key accounts in FRANCE Define and execute on a long-term building pipeline strategy, while closing in quarter opportunities Ascertain Apple’s assigned accounts adoption, growth strategies, and business plans Prescribe short-term and long-term solutions to achieve customer and client goals Manage and support in complex enterprise sales campaigns while managing a diverse set of stakeholders, partners, and Apple team members within the same account Structure and negotiate sales & legal agreements with clients. Work closely with Apple and channel partners to develop and execute strategies toward generating opportunities Utilize internal and competitive data to benchmark sales performance and determine strategic implications Creates an environment where all job responsibilities are in alignment with the core values, mission and purpose of the organization Fosters a workplace with the highest moral, ethical and legal standards to deliver an environment that promotes respect, innovation and creativity Models a positive, inclusive workplace one in which the talents and strengths of our increasingly diverse workforce are welcomed, further developed and manifested in our work   What we are looking for:   Professional working proficiency in French and English (required). 3+ years of selling experience in related (IT/Software/SaaS) technology industry with demonstrated quota achievement. (required) 1+ Years’ experience in selling into Large Corporate, Enterprise accounts and/or FTSE accounts with demonstrated achievement (required) Experience in the endpoint technology IT industry and familiarity with the Apple platform (preferred) Proven track record collaborating with channel reseller and/or direct touch customers with demonstrated target achievement (preferred) Ability to accurately forecast business weekly, on a monthly and quarterly basis Familiarity with Salesforce Proven ability to work effectively across all levels of business and IT contacts within large and complex organizations, including legal, procurement and executive teams. At least one year of experience working in the region. 10% travelling expected   SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS   Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory. Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches. Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.   Why Jamf?   Named a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, 2021. We put people over profits – which is why our customers keep coming back to us. We encourage you to simply be you. title: Director, Pharmacometrics
description: Step into a role where science meets strategy and your expertise shapes the future of drug development. As a Director, Pharmacometrician, you’ll lead high-impact modeling and simulation efforts within a dynamic Clinical Pharmacology, Modeling and Simulation (CPMS) environment. You’ll guide teams, mentor pharmacometricians, and provide strategic insight to clients at key development milestones. This role also offers the opportunity to represent clients in interactions with regulatory agencies. If you thrive on collaboration and solving complex scientific challenges, this is your chance to make a meaningful impact. About the role This role combines scientific leadership and strategic impact, leading population PK analyses while developing innovative approaches to improve efficiency and accuracy. You will design, analyze, and interpret clinical pharmacology studies, provide strategic guidance to clients, and contribute to regulatory documents and agency interactions. In addition, you’ll foster client relationships, support business development, and stay at the forefront of PK/PD advancements to drive continuous improvement. Your main responsibilities will include but not limited to: Lead and conduct population PK analyses using advanced modeling tools and methodologies Develop and implement innovative approaches to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of PK analysis Design, analyze, and interpret clinical pharmacology studies (renal, hepatic, TQT, ADME, DDI, BE/BA, SAD, MAD, etc.) and provide guidance to optimize pharmacokinetic sampling and dosing strategies Provide strategic guidance to clients, owning deliverables and developing clinical pharmacology plans Author and review PK reports and clinical pharmacology sections of regulatory documents Represent clients in regulatory interactions and contribute to business development and relationship management Requirements About You If you are a driven clinical pharmacology professional with 6–10 years of experience in drug development and pharmacometrics and you bring sharp analytical thinking and expertise in tools like NONMEM, Pirana, and R to deliver high-impact insights while being client-focused and a natural leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, combining strategic thinking, strong communication, and business acumen to build relationships and drive results, this role is for you. To be successful we are looking for the following traits and behaviors: Life science, healthcare and/or business degree Minimum 10 years of relevant work experience, including experience in drug development, clinical pharmacology, and pharmacometrics Regulatory experience including regulatory report writing essential. Experience with regulatory submissions including INDs, CTAs, regulatory meetings and NDA/BLA/MAA submissions Proficiency in NONMEM, Pirana, and R software preferred Excellent organizational, negotiating and financial skills Benefits About Allucent Our mission is to help bring new therapies to light. When you work at Allucent, that means rolling up your sleeves and applying your unique skill set, expertise, and knowledge to build partnerships with our clients in their pursuit to develop new, life-improving treatments. If you're passionate about helping customers develop new pharmaceuticals and biologics; have an entrepreneurial spirit; and ready to join other science, business, and operations leaders, we would love to get to learn more about how we can help each other grow. title: Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d)
description: Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus Connected Growers entwickelt June - die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, B2B Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung als Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d), um nicht nur Software zu entwickeln, sondern ein Team aufzubauen, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team die Zukunft unserer Plattform zu gestalten. Deine Rolle bei June Als Tech Lead Grower Marketplace Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die technische Entwicklung unseres Marketplace und der dazugehörigen Services. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CTO Anna. Du baust einen neuen Engineering Squad von Grund auf auf und übernimmst die technische und fachliche Verantwortung für einen der kommerziell wichtigsten Bereiche von June. Es geht nicht nur darum, gute Software zu bauen: Du setzt technische Richtung, triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit, entwickelst Menschen, und prägst die Kultur deines Squads. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen. Wir geben dir den Kontext und den Freiraum, den du brauchst, um deinen Bereich eigenständig zu führen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen. Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln. Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem Spryker Commerce OS . Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick. Anforderungen Was du mitbringst Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Tech Lead oder Senior Engineer in Web- und E-Commerce-Anwendungen sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit PHP und Spryker Commerce OS und weißt, wann du innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeitest, erweiterst oder bewusst davon abweichst. Du bringst Erfahrung mit API- bzw. Spec-first-Entwicklung sowie mit AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen, modernen Deployment-Prozessen und Monitoring mit. Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt. Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen). Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch. Das wäre ein Plus Gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript. Erfahrung mit ERP-, Warehouse- oder Commerce-Systemen. Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen. Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen. Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst Du verantwortest Architektur, technische Qualität und Weiterentwicklung des Marketplace und seiner Services. Du baust dein Squad auf, entwickelst deine Teammitglieder weiter und schaffst eine Kultur aus Ownership, Pragmatismus und kontinuierlichem Lernen. Du entwickelst eine klare technische Strategie für den Produktbereich Marketplace Experience und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen darüber, wie wir Spryker einsetzen und erweitern. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen.. Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert – von der technischen Spezifikation und Architektur über API-Design und Entwicklung bis hin zu Betrieb, Incident Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Performance, Stabilität, Security und Compliance und stellst sicher, dass technische Risiken früh erkannt, bewertet und bewusst adressiert werden. Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag und hilfst deinem Team dabei, AI sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll für Entwicklung, Testing, Dokumentation und Code Reviews einzusetzen. So arbeiten wir Unsere Teams verantworten ihren Produktbereich komplett: Architektur, API-Design, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Incidents, Security, Compliance. Die kommerziellen KPIs gehören dazu. Wir reden mit Kunden, fahren zu ihnen raus, testen unsere Lösungen dort im Betrieb. Verantwortung endet nicht am Merge-Button. Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet Du baust etwas auf, statt ein bestehendes Team zu verwalten. Du bekommst einen klar abgegrenzten Verantwortungsbereich und die Freiheit, ihn zu gestalten. Du arbeitest direkt mit CTO und Product Manager und kannst technische, produktbezogene, kulturprägende und kommerzielle Entscheidungen tatsächlich beeinflussen. Du siehst die Konsequenzen deiner Entscheidungen unmittelbar – im Produkt, im Team und im Geschäft. Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei Kund*innen, Gärtner*innen und Partner*innen vor Ort Diese Stellenbeschreibung ist bewusst meinungsstark und setzt hohe Standards. Wir suchen nicht den perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern Menschen, die bei Connected Growers glücklich werden. Wenn du nicht alle formalen Kriterien erfüllst, dich aber in der Art, wie wir arbeiten und führen, wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Was dir an einzelnen Punkten noch fehlt, können wir gemeinsam entwickeln – entscheidend ist, dass du das Mindset und die Bereitschaft mitbringst, in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen. Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über BridgeMaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Stage Master 2 : Elaboration de panneaux biosourcés à base de pailles
description: L'IMT Mines Alès, grande école de prestige qui se classe parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs sur le plan national et mondial et implantée à Alès, ville à taille humaine, capitale des Cévennes où la qualité de vie est fortement appréciée par ses habitants. Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr Contexte : Le stage à pourvoir s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet européen Best-Crop impliquant 18 partenaires à l’échelle européenne : https://www.bestcrop.eu/ dont le but est de contribuer à développer l’économie circulaire en offrant de nouvelles variétés d’orge à rendement amélioré ( article de perspective – projet Best-Crop ). ). L’un des volets du projet consiste à fournir des pailles d’orge de composition et/ou structure optimisées pour différentes applications, dont, entre autres, le secteur de la construction (fabrication de panneaux de particules et de biocomposites). Dans le cadre de ce projet, l’équipe PCH a pour tâche d’étudier l’influence de la sélection et du fractionnement des pailles issues de différentes variétés d’orge, ainsi que d’étudier la microstructure et le comportement mécanique de panneaux biosourcés élaborés par pressage à chaud. Objectifs : Le stage consiste à mettre en œuvre des panneaux de pailles, d’optimiser le procédé de fabrication, et d’évaluer la variabilité des comportements mécaniques et d’isolation observés en regard de la composition et de la morphologie des pailles pour développer des panneaux performants. Le travail contribuera également à compléter la large base de données sur les panneaux à renforts lignocellulosiques développés au laboratoire. Vous trouverez davantage d’informations sur le stage ici : https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/nRzezN9XJz7gYLS Compétences et connaissances : Élève de formation BAC+5 (Master 2) en science et génie des matériaux polymères et composites Connaissances dans le domaine des biocomposites à fibres végétales Production scientifique (rédaction de publications, de posters, présentations orales ...) title: TECH LEAD IA H/F
description: Le rôle Équiper des équipes de LLM et de coding agents prend un après-midi. Les faire travailler en AI-Native SDLC, c'est-à-dire concevoir et livrer du logiciel avec des agents dans la boucle plutôt qu'à côté, demande de faire évoluer tout l'environnement autour : architecture, gestion du contexte, harness (la couche système qui donne à un agent ses outils, ses permissions et son contexte d'exécution), developer platforms, intégration au SI, infrastructure, sécurité, observabilité, évaluation. Comme Tech Lead, tu aides nos clients à comprendre ces transformations, tu arbitres les décisions d'architecture qui en découlent et tu mets en place les capacités qui leur manquent. Tu conçois, tu conseilles, et tu descends dans le code quand il faut confronter une décision au réel. Pourquoi on ouvre ce poste Nos clients ont dépassé le stade du POC. Leur question porte maintenant sur l'intégration des agents au SI et au cycle de delivery, et sur ce qui doit être mutualisé dans une plateforme plutôt que laissé à chaque équipe. Ce sont des questions d'architecture, et on n'a personne dont c'est le métier à plein temps. Tes missions 🎯 • comprendre le contexte Product, business et technologique du client, son SI et son environnement de delivery • identifier ce que l'IA change et les capacités technologiques qui manquent pour y répondre • concevoir les architectures et arbitrer les choix structurants : build ou buy, plateforme ou équipe, standardisation ou autonomie, besoin immédiat ou capacité durable • prototyper ou implémenter certains composants quand une décision d'architecture a besoin d'être éprouvée • accompagner les équipes client et faire monter les équipes Thiga en compétence • intervenir en avant-vente comme garant technique, challenger les demandes et aider le client à transformer un problème flou en décision Deux exemples de ce que ça donne concrètement 👀 Passer à l'échelle avec les coding agents Le cas du début. Tu analyses l'existant, tu identifies les capacités manquantes et tu conçois l'architecture qui permet aux équipes et aux agents de travailler ensemble de façon observable et sécurisée. Le vrai sujet est souvent le knowledge : reconstruire un contexte exploitable à partir de repos, de docs et de conventions que personne n'a maintenus depuis trois ans. Décider ce qui se mutualise Cinq équipes expérimentent chacune avec leurs propres modèles, agents et outils. Tu aides le client à trancher ce qui remonte dans une plateforme, ce qui reste décentralisé et dans quel ordre y aller. La réponse est rarement la grande plateforme IA. C'est plus souvent trois capacités bien choisies qui débloquent tout le monde. Avec qui tu travailles 🤝 Chez nos clients : CTO, responsables Engineering, architectes, Platform Engineers, développeurs, équipes sécurité et Product. Tu dois pouvoir passer d'une discussion d'architecture très technique à une décision avec un dirigeant dans la même journée. Chez Thiga : nos Product Builders, Product Engineers et consultants Product. Ton rôle est de construire les enablers technologiques qui leur permettent de tirer parti de l'IA sur leurs missions, et de les faire progresser. Ton profil 🚀 Une culture Tech large Tu es d'abord un bon technologue. Tu comprends assez bien les systèmes logiciels modernes pour raisonner sur une architecture entière : software architecture, systèmes distribués, APIs, données, cloud, infrastructure, sécurité, IAM, CI/CD, developer platforms, observabilité. On cherche quelqu'un capable de repérer ce qui est structurant, de comprendre les interactions entre les couches et d'aller en profondeur quand le problème l'exige, plutôt qu'un spécialiste de chacune de ces disciplines. Tu as assez de kilomètres au compteur, souvent une dizaine d'années, pour avoir vu des architectures évoluer, atteindre leurs limites et parfois échouer. Une vraie profondeur IA Tu comprends les systèmes construits avec des LLM et des agents, ce qu'ils permettent et où ils coincent. Context engineering, retrieval, tool use, systèmes agentiques, evals, sécurité, observabilité : tu sais raisonner sur les propriétés architecturales que ces systèmes introduisent et sur ce qu'elles impliquent pour le reste du SI. Du jugement, et des mains Tu raisonnes en trade-offs, tu prends position et tu expliques pourquoi une option est préférable dans un contexte donné, sans confondre architecture et accumulation de technologies. Et tu es resté assez hands-on pour ouvrir le code, manipuler des APIs, explorer une infra ou monter un prototype quand ça devient le moyen le plus rapide de savoir. Une culture Product et client Tu cherches à comprendre le problème, les utilisateurs, les contraintes de l'organisation et le résultat attendu avant de dessiner une solution. Tu sais challenger un client, poser plusieurs options avec leurs compromis, puis l'aider à décider. Apprécié Une expérience du conseil, des transformations Product & Engineering, des developer platforms ou des systèmes IA en production. Si tu écris, contribues à de l'open source ou parles en conférence, c'est un vrai plus. Pourquoi Thiga 👀 Thiga vient du Product Management, ce qui change la manière d'aborder l'AI-Native SDLC. Cette transformation touche la technologie, le produit et la façon dont les équipes travaillent en même temps, donc on refuse de la traiter comme un simple sujet d'outillage ou de plateforme. Tu seras rattaché à la Tribe Tech & IA, qui réunit nos Product Builders, les consultants qui déploient l'AI-Native SDLC chez nos clients et les architectes qui en construisent les enablers. Notre ambition : mener de vraies transformations chez nos clients, construire un collectif d'experts qui partage réellement ce qu'il apprend, et faire reconnaître Thiga comme un acteur de référence sur le sujet. Il y a donc une vraie dimension intrapreneuriale, et la liberté qui va avec. Process de recrutement 🎢 1. Premier échange avec une Chargée de recrutement : ton parcours, ce que tu cherches, et une présentation précise de Thiga et du rôle. 2. Cas et soutenance : on t'envoie un cas une semaine avant. L'exercice ne consiste pas à retrouver notre architecture ou à réciter une stack, on veut voir comment tu abordes un problème complexe, comment tu explores les options, comment tu arbitres et comment tu défends une recommandation. On évalue quatre dimensions : profondeur Tech, profondeur IA, culture Product, posture de conseil. 3. Rencontre finale avec un.e Directeur.rice : approfondir ce qui doit l'être et valider l'envie de travailler ensemble, des deux côtés. Notre culture Chez Thiga, nous vivons selon des principes forts : Product first Nous pensons produit dans sa globalité, de l'expérience utilisateur jusqu'à l'infrastructure. Hands-on or nothing Notre approche est radicalement pratique. Nous croyons en la démonstration concrète plutôt qu'en la théorie. Market Maker by Design Nous repoussons les limites et partageons ouvertement nos innovations. Knowledge Open Bar Le savoir n'a de valeur que lorsqu'il est largement partagé. Nous diffusons librement nos apprentissages et nos outils. Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: CENTRALE LYON ENISE - Post doctorat - Modélisation et optimisation de la sphéroïdisation de poudres métalliques par plasma RF
tags: LTDS - Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes
description: Le poste est basé à Centrale Lyon ENISE, sur le campus stéphanois, qui accueille plus de 1250 élèves et 160 personnels, dans un environnement exceptionnel aux portes du Pilat. Centrale Lyon ENISE forme des ingénieurs de spécialité Génie mécanique, Génie civil, Génie sensoriel sous statut étudiant (FISE) ou sous statut apprenti (FISA). DESCRIPTIF Contexte scientifique : Dans le cadre d'un projet ANR consacré au traitement et à la fonctionnalisation de poudres métalliques par plasma radiofréquence, le laboratoire souhaite recruter un post-doc pour développer une approche couplant modélisation physique, expérimentation et optimisation des paramètres de procédé. Le travail portera principalement sur la sphéroïdisation de poudres d'AlSi10Mg par plasma RF inductif, réalisée sur une torche TekSphero40 (40 kW). Le procédé vise à transformer des particules initialement irrégulières en particules sphériques adaptées notamment aux procédés de fabrication additive métallique. Le projet s'intéresse à un problème scientifique fortement couplé. L'augmentation de l'énergie apportée aux particules favorise leur fusion et leur sphéroïdisation, mais peut simultanément accentuer l'évaporation du magnésium, la formation de nanoparticules et la coalescence des particules en vol. L'objectif est donc de rechercher un compromis optimal entre plusieurs critères de qualité de la poudre. Verrous scientifiques : La fabrication additive métallique par fusion laser sur lit de poudre (L-PBF) nécessite des poudres très sphériques, coulables et chimiquement homogènes. Le procédé de sphéroïdisation par plasma à couplage inductif radiofréquence (RF) est une voie industrielle intéressante pour répondre à ces besoins. Dans ce procédé, la poudre traverse un plasma d'argon à 10 000 K, fond en vol (~ 5 -150 ms) et se resolidifie en gouttelette sphérique sous l'effet de la tension de surface. La qualité finale des poudres dépend de quatre paramètres opératoires principaux : la puissance du procédé, le débit de poudre, les débits de gaz (central, gaine, porteur), et la position axiale de la sonde d'injection de poudre dans le plasma. Sur la torche TekSphero40 (20-40 kW) et pour l'AlSi10Mg, trois verrous scientifiques sont identifiés et doivent être levés simultanément : • Verrou 1 : Coalescence des particules : les gouttelettes fondues, en raison de leur faible viscosité, fusionnent lors de collisions en vol, provoquant un grossissement non contrôlé de la distribution granulométrique. Ceci a été particulièrement observé dans nos essais sur la sphéroïdisation de AlSi10Mg. Dans la littérature, cet effet a été rapporté sur une poudre de tungstène (Zhu et al. 2017). • Verrou 2 : Évaporation des éléments légers : le magnésium (Tvap = 1091 °C) s'évapore préférentiellement dans le plasma, provoquant un appauvrissement en Mg de l'alliage (perte de la phase durcissante Mg₂Si) et la formation de fumées métalliques. • Verrou 3 : Formation de nanoparticules : les vapeurs métalliques produite dans le plasma conduisent à la condensation en nanoparticules polluantes et parfois, de dépôts satellites sur les grosses particules. Ces trois verrous sont couplés : augmenter la puissance ou le temps de séjour améliore la sphéricité mais aggrave la coalescence et l'évaporation. Le problème est intrinsèquement multi-objectifs et aucune solution "toute faite" n'existe dans la littérature pour cet alliage. MISSION ET ACTIVITES Le post-doc développera un modèle permettant de prédire le comportement des particules dans le plasma en considérant trois phénomènes physiques principaux : • Fusion et sphéroïdisation : établir le bilan énergétique entre le plasma et les particules afin de déterminer les conditions permettant leur fusion complète et leur transformation en particules sphériques. • Évaporation du magnésium : modéliser la perte préférentielle de Mg lorsque les particules atteignent des températures élevées, en reliant température, temps de séjour et cinétique d'évaporation. • Coalescence : étudier les collisions et la fusion entre particules en vol afin de prédire leur évolution granulométrique. Ces trois phénomènes seront ensuite couplés dans une approche d'optimisation multi-objectifs, afin d'identifier les conditions permettant de maximiser la sphéroïdisation tout en limitant la perte de Mg, la formation de nanoparticules et l'élargissement de la distribution granulométrique. Le travail comportera une forte interaction entre modélisation et expérimentation. Les prédictions seront confrontées à des essais réalisés sur la TekSphero-40 et à la caractérisation des poudres par MEB, diffraction laser, mesure de densité apparente et ICP-AES. Un plan d'expériences sera notamment utilisé pour calibrer et valider les modèles. Activités principales : 1.Acquérir des connaissances sur le procédé de sphéroïdisation plasma RF 2.Développer les modèles physiques 3. Développer une approche de modélisation numérique 4. Mettre en œuvre une stratégie d'optimisation 5.Conduire et analyser les expérimentations Diplôme requis pour les contractuels : doctorat Spécialité/domaine (facultatif) : génie des procédés, génie mécanique, science et génie des matériaux, métallurgie, physique des plasmas, thermique et énergétique, mécanique des fluides ou domaine scientifique proche. Une expérience directe en plasma thermique ou en sphéroïdisation de poudres serait appréciée, mais elle n'est pas indispensable. Le candidat devra surtout posséder une solide formation scientifique lui permettant d'acquérir rapidement les connaissances spécifiques au procédé. Connaissances : Le/la candidat(e) devra disposer de bonnes bases dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : transferts thermiques, thermodynamique, mécanique des fluides, phénomènes de transport, science des matériaux et métallurgie, modélisation physique, méthodes numériques, statistiques et plans d'expériences. Une bonne compréhension des phénomènes de changement de phase, de transfert de chaleur, de transport de matière et de cinétique est particulièrement recherchée. Le projet nécessite également une capacité à passer d'une description physique du phénomène à un modèle mathématique exploitable numériquement. Savoir-être : Nous recherchons un(e) jeune chercheur(se) autonome, curieux(se) et capable d'aborder un problème physique complexe, de formuler des hypothèses, de développer un modèle, de le confronter à l'expérience et de l'améliorer sur la base des résultats obtenus. Le poste offre la possibilité de travailler à l'interface de plusieurs domaines : Plasma RF → Transferts thermiques → Métallurgie des poudres → Modélisation → Expérimentation → Optimisation → Fabrication additive. Architecture & Développement (Hands-on) : Concevoir et développer les briques applicatives (majoritairement les microservices back-end en Node.js, tout en gardant une vision sur l'intégration front). Implémenter la logique complexe des opérations (règles de jeu, gains, validations) et gérer les problématiques de haute volumétrie. Porter la vision technique de l'équipe : choix d'architecture, structuration des projets, définition des spécifications techniques. Assurer la mise en production et le suivi post-production (stabilité, monitoring, alertes, gestion des incidents). ENVIRONNEMENT & ENJEUX TECHNIQUES Back-end : Node.js (TypeScript non transpilé avec JSDoc). Écosystème Fullstack : capacité à interagir et guider l'équipe sur les enjeux Front-end (React/Vue, animation, intégration web) liés aux mini-jeux. Événementiel : Kafka (consumer groups, reprocessing, gestion des erreurs). API publiques : contrats stables, versioning, performance et backward compatibility. Performance temps réel : faible latence, fort débit, observabilité (logs, métriques). Concurrence & fiabilité : idempotence, gestion des retries, race conditions. Données : MySQL (modélisation, transactions, optimisation des requêtes). Redis / Valkey (cache-aside, cohérence cache / DB, réduction de latence). Architecture : Hexagonale (ports & adapters), forte exigence de testabilité et maintenabilité. Très à l'aise avec les systèmes distribués, la forte charge et les problématiques de scalabilité, tu portes un intérêt prononcé au clean code et à la construction de systèmes ultra-fiables en production. Enfin, autonome, pragmatique et doté d'un excellent relationnel, tu t'épanouiras pleinement dans un environnement où tes livraisons auront un impact direct. title: Senior Post-Market Surveillance Manager (m/f/d)
description: Company & Role Overview About Hilo by Aktiia High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. description: Mission The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.   Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. Collaborate closely with product designers, UX researchers, QA, and other stakeholders to shape feature planning, UI/UX architecture, and long-term roadmap for the Windows platform. Previous experience in shaping CI/CD workflows, release pipelines, and deployment strategies for desktop applications.
